Test Scenario: Verify user can register with valid details
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Registration page
2. Enter valid Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password
3. Click Register
Expected Result: Account is created successfully; confirmation message/email is shown; user is redirected to login or homepage

Test Scenario: Verify system rejects registration with an already-registered email
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Registration page
2. Enter an email that already exists in the system
3. Fill remaining fields with valid data
4. Click Register
Expected Result: System displays an error message: 'Email already registered'; account is not created

Test Scenario: Verify system validates password and confirm-password mismatch
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Registration page
2. Enter valid details
3. Enter different values in Password and Confirm Password fields
4. Click Register
Expected Result: System displays validation error: 'Passwords do not match'; registration is blocked

Test Scenario: Verify mandatory field validation on Registration form
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Registration page
2. Leave one or more mandatory fields blank
3. Click Register
Expected Result: System displays 'This field is required' messages for each blank mandatory field; form is not submitted

Test Scenario: Verify email format validation on Registration form
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Registration page
2. Enter an invalid email format (e.g. 'abc@com')
3. Fill remaining fields with valid data
4. Click Register
Expected Result: System displays 'Invalid email format' error; registration is blocked

Test Scenario: Verify user can log in with valid credentials
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Enter registered email and correct password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is authenticated and redirected to the homepage/dashboard; username is displayed in the header

Test Scenario: Verify login fails with incorrect password
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Enter a registered email with an incorrect password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: System displays 'Invalid email or password' error; user is not logged in

Test Scenario: Verify login fails with unregistered email
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Enter an email that is not registered
3. Enter any password
4. Click Login
Expected Result: System displays 'Invalid email or password' error; user is not logged in

Test Scenario: Verify 'Forgot Password' link sends a reset email
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Click 'Forgot Password'
3. Enter registered email
4. Click Submit
Expected Result: System displays confirmation that a password reset link has been sent to the registered email

Test Scenario: Verify session is terminated after Logout
Test Steps:
1. Log in with valid credentials
2. Click Logout
3. Click browser Back button
Expected Result: User is logged out and redirected to the login/home page; protected pages are not accessible via Back button

Test Scenario: Verify account lockout/behavior after multiple failed login attempts
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Login page
2. Enter a registered email with an incorrect password 5 times consecutively
Expected Result: System displays an appropriate lockout/warning message or CAPTCHA after repeated failed attempts

Test Scenario: Verify user can browse the full book catalog
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to homepage
2. Click 'Browse Books' or catalog menu
Expected Result: List of available books is displayed with title, author, price, and cover image for each book

Test Scenario: Verify user can filter catalog by category/genre
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to catalog page
2. Select a specific category (e.g. Fiction)
Expected Result: Only books belonging to the selected category are displayed

Test Scenario: Verify pagination works correctly on the catalog page
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to catalog page with more than one page of results
2. Click 'Next' page
3. Click 'Previous' page
Expected Result: Correct set of books is displayed on each page; page number/indicator updates accordingly

Test Scenario: Verify catalog displays 'No books available' when a category is empty
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to catalog page
2. Select a category that currently has zero books
Expected Result: System displays an appropriate empty-state message instead of an error or blank page

Test Scenario: Verify user can search for a book by exact title
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to homepage
2. Enter the exact title of an existing book in the search bar
3. Click Search
Expected Result: The matching book is displayed in the search results

Test Scenario: Verify search returns relevant results for a partial keyword
Test Steps:
1. Enter a partial keyword (e.g. first 3 letters of a book title) in the search bar
2. Click Search
Expected Result: All books whose title/author contains the keyword are displayed

Test Scenario: Verify search with no matching results displays an appropriate message
Test Steps:
1. Enter a random string that matches no book (e.g. 'zzzxcvqwe') in the search bar
2. Click Search
Expected Result: System displays 'No results found' message; no error or broken page is shown

Test Scenario: Verify search field rejects/handles special characters and script input safely
Test Steps:
1. Enter special characters or a script tag (e.g. <script>alert(1)</script>) into the search bar
2. Click Search
Expected Result: Input is safely handled/sanitized; no script executes and no application error occurs

Test Scenario: Verify search is case-insensitive
Test Steps:
1. Enter a book title in all uppercase or mixed case
2. Click Search
Expected Result: Matching book(s) are returned regardless of case used in the search term

Test Scenario: Verify book detail page displays complete and correct information
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to catalog
2. Click on a book
Expected Result: Book detail page displays title, author, price, description, cover image, and availability/stock status

Test Scenario: Verify 'Add to Cart' button is available and functional on the detail page
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to a book's detail page
2. Click 'Add to Cart'
Expected Result: Book is added to the cart; cart icon/count updates; confirmation message is displayed

Test Scenario: Verify out-of-stock books are indicated and cannot be added to cart
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the detail page of a book with zero stock
Expected Result: 'Out of Stock' label is displayed; 'Add to Cart' button is disabled or shows an appropriate message

Test Scenario: Verify user can add multiple different books to the cart
Test Steps:
1. Add Book A to cart
2. Navigate back to catalog
3. Add Book B to cart
4. Open cart
Expected Result: Both books are listed in the cart with correct quantities, prices, and a correct subtotal

Test Scenario: Verify user can update item quantity in the cart
Test Steps:
1. Open cart with at least one item
2. Increase/decrease quantity using the quantity control
3. Click Update
Expected Result: Quantity and line-item/subtotal totals update correctly and immediately

Test Scenario: Verify user can remove an item from the cart
Test Steps:
1. Open cart with at least one item
2. Click 'Remove' on an item
Expected Result: Item is removed from the cart; totals recalculate correctly; empty-cart message shown if cart becomes empty

Test Scenario: Verify cart quantity cannot be set below 1 or above available stock
Test Steps:
1. Open cart with an item
2. Attempt to set quantity to 0 or to a value greater than available stock
Expected Result: System prevents the invalid quantity and displays an appropriate validation message

Test Scenario: Verify cart contents persist after page refresh
Test Steps:
1. Add a book to cart
2. Refresh the browser page
Expected Result: Cart still contains the previously added item(s) with correct quantities

Test Scenario: Verify user can complete checkout with valid shipping and payment details
Test Steps:
1. Add item(s) to cart
2. Proceed to Checkout
3. Enter valid shipping address
4. Enter valid payment details
5. Click Place Order
Expected Result: Order is placed successfully; order summary is displayed with correct items, quantities, and total

Test Scenario: Verify checkout is blocked when mandatory shipping fields are missing
Test Steps:
1. Proceed to Checkout
2. Leave a mandatory shipping field blank
3. Click Place Order
Expected Result: System displays validation error(s) and does not proceed to payment/order placement

Test Scenario: Verify checkout is blocked with an invalid/expired card
Test Steps:
1. Proceed to Checkout with a valid address
2. Enter an invalid or expired card number
3. Click Place Order
Expected Result: System displays a payment error message; order is not placed and cart remains unchanged

Test Scenario: Verify order total correctly includes tax and shipping charges
Test Steps:
1. Add item(s) to cart with a known price
2. Proceed to Checkout
3. Review order summary before placing order
Expected Result: Displayed total equals subtotal + tax + shipping, matching the system's stated calculation

Test Scenario: Verify user cannot checkout with an empty cart
Test Steps:
1. Ensure cart is empty
2. Attempt to navigate directly to the Checkout page
Expected Result: User is redirected to the cart/homepage with a message indicating the cart is empty

Test Scenario: Verify order confirmation page displays correct order details
Test Steps: 1. Complete a successful checkout
Expected Result: Confirmation page displays a unique Order ID, ordered items, quantities, total amount, and estimated delivery info

Test Scenario: Verify order confirmation email is sent after successful checkout
Test Steps: 1. Complete a successful checkout using a valid registered email
Expected Result: An order confirmation email is received containing the Order ID and order summary

Test Scenario: Verify placed order appears in the user's Order History
Test Steps:
1. Complete a successful checkout
2. Navigate to 'My Orders' / Order History
Expected Result: The newly placed order appears in the order history with correct status, date, and total
